ACTION / PLATFORMER

Gunslugs

Run, jump and shoot through chaotic pixel-art battlefields, smash scenery and rescue characters in this action platformer by Orangepixel.

ARM64 LINUXGAME FILES REQUIRED
Required game version: Android 3.2.4

This port requires the Android APK from the Epic Games Store. A Windows installer is not used. Follow the APK version and fingerprint requirements below. The port release number is separate from the original game version.

Source & updates on GitHub ↗

Port files only. Purchase the original game separately.

Get the game on Epic Games Store (Android) ↗

Bring your game

On your Android device, buy and install Gunslugs from the Epic Games Store mobile app. This port requires Gunslugs 3.2.4. Check the installed version before backing it up. Gunslugs store page.

Back up the installed APK with AnExplorer:

1. Open AnExplorer. 2. On the Home screen, tap Apps. This shows all installed applications on your device. 3. Find Gunslugs by scrolling the list or using the search bar. 4. Long-press the app icon or name. 5. Tap Backup from the context menu. 6. AnExplorer saves the APK to Internal Storage/Backup/Apps/[AppName].apk. 7. A confirmation appears showing the file was saved successfully.

Install the port

  1. Update PortMaster. Copy gunslugs.zip into its autoinstall/ folder and open PortMaster.
  2. Allow PortMaster to download Java 17 and Westonpack. An internet connection is needed if these runtimes are not installed.
  3. Copy the owned game files into gunslugs/ as described above. Launch Gunslugs from your ports menu.
